STEP 1 - Scene: A single slice-like piece of baked pizza or focaccia-style flatbread with melted cheese and tomato sauce, on a white plate. Photographed from above, nearly top-down.

STEP 2 - Ruler: White dinner-style plate, roughly 22-24 cm diameter. Using 23 cm: area = 3.14 x (11.5)^2 ≈ 415 cm^2.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Pizza/flatbread pieces (two adjoining pieces with crust edges)
- Melted mozzarella-type cheese
- Tomato sauce

STEP 4 - Area: The food covers roughly 2 pieces forming a footprint about 9 x 9 cm in total, around 120 cm^2, about 29% of the plate. Cheese ~17% (about 70 cm^2), bread base/crust ~10% (about 42 cm^2), tomato sauce is spotted over the cheese and crust, counted within the same areas (~3%, about 12 cm^2 of visible sauce on top). Total food footprint ≈ 29%.

STEP 5 - Volume: Pizza-like pieces are about 1.5-2 cm thick at the crust and thinner over the cheese. Estimated gross volume ≈ 120 cm^2 x 1.5 cm ≈ 180 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams: Bread-like/cheesy baked item at bulk density ~0.9 g/ml gives ≈ 160 g.

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Baked flatbread/crust base, about 60% of mass ≈ 96 g x 260 kcal/100 g ≈ 250 kcal
- Mozzarella cheese topping, about 30% ≈ 48 g x 280 kcal/100 g ≈ 134 kcal
- Tomato sauce, about 10% ≈ 16 g x 30 kcal/100 g ≈ 5 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Two modest slice-sized pieces of cheese pizza is plausible at roughly 160 g and about 390 kcal. This is a visible portion only, not a full pizza.
